title: xppautX .odex options
description: The options block of a .odex model: options { group: { key: value, ... }, ... }. Generated from core/model_options.cpp by xppautX --options-schema; the JSON form of the block's dictionary. A key marked x-repeatable may be written more than once; a path or a text is a double-quoted string, sliders a list of presets, curves a list of curves, every other value one bare word. default is the value a session with no model gives the key (a value a model sets, a name or a node count, has none); x-key is the key of the numerics event and of set num; x-advanced marks an option that tunes a method's inside (a tolerance, an iteration cap, a step floor), whose default is right for almost every model.

animation.title: Animation
animation.description: The animation file the window plays beside a run.

total_time.title: Total time
total_time.description: How long a run integrates, in model time. From an XPPAUT .ode: TOTAL.

start_time.title: Start time
start_time.description: The time a run starts at. From an XPPAUT .ode: T0.

dt.title: Dt
dt.description: The time step of a fixed-step method, and the first step of an adaptive one. From an XPPAUT .ode: DT.

store_every.title: Store every N steps
store_every.description: Keep one step of every this many in the data table. From an XPPAUT .ode: NOUT, NJMP.

store_from.title: Store from
store_from.description: Keep no data before this time; the run before it is a transient. From an XPPAUT .ode: TRANS.

storage_precision.title: Storage precision
storage_precision.description: What the data table keeps each value as: a single-precision float as XPPAUT does, or the integrator's double.

state_limit.title: State limit
state_limit.description: A state beyond plus or minus this value stops the run. From an XPPAUT .ode: BOUND (which also sets equilibria.newton.search_limit): the one value is both limits.

stop_at_limit.title: Stop at the limit
stop_at_limit.description: Whether a state beyond the state limit stops the run, or only marks it.

method.title: Method
method.description: The integration method. From an XPPAUT .ode: METH, METHOD.

subsystem_split.title: Subsystem split
subsystem_split.description: What splits the model into independent subsystems: its equations alone, or also the run (a Poincare section or stop).

compile.title: Compile
compile.description: Whether the equations run as compiled code or in the interpreter; a change applies when the model next loads.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The seed of the random numbers a run draws; the same seed gives the same run. From an XPPAUT .ode: SEED.

step.relative_tolerance.title: Relative tolerance
step.relative_tolerance.description: The relative error an adaptive method accepts in one step. From an XPPAUT .ode: TOL.

step.absolute_tolerance.title: Absolute tolerance
step.absolute_tolerance.description: The absolute error an adaptive method accepts in one step. From an XPPAUT .ode: ATOL.

step.min.title: Minimum step
step.min.description: The smallest step an adaptive method takes before it gives up. From an XPPAUT .ode: DTMIN.

step.max.title: Maximum step
step.max.description: The largest step an adaptive method takes. From an XPPAUT .ode: DTMAX.

global.min_step_fraction.title: Global minimum step fraction
global.min_step_fraction.description: The smallest fraction of a step a global event's crossing is placed at; a crossing is moved this far past its root.

jacobian.kind.title: Jacobian
jacobian.kind.description: Whether an implicit method gets the Jacobian by differences or from the exact derivatives.

jacobian.band_upper.title: Jacobian band upper
jacobian.band_upper.description: The diagonals above the main one that a banded Jacobian keeps. From an XPPAUT .ode: BANDUP.

jacobian.band_lower.title: Jacobian band lower
jacobian.band_lower.description: The diagonals below the main one that a banded Jacobian keeps. From an XPPAUT .ode: BANDLO.

delay.max_delay.title: Maximal delay
delay.max_delay.description: The longest delay a model uses; it sets how much history is kept. From an XPPAUT .ode: DELAY.

delay.history_points.title: Delay history points
delay.history_points.description: How many past points of the history the Volterra method keeps for an integral equation. From an XPPAUT .ode: VMAXPTS.

delay.real_guess.title: Delay real guess
delay.real_guess.description: The largest real part the search for a delay equilibrium's eigenvalues looks for.

delay.imaginary_guess.title: Delay imaginary guess
delay.imaginary_guess.description: The largest imaginary part the search for a delay equilibrium's eigenvalues looks for.

delay.grid.title: Delay grid
delay.grid.description: How many points a side the grid of a delay equilibrium's eigenvalue search has.

euler.tolerance.title: Newton tolerance
euler.tolerance.description: The Newton tolerance of the implicit Euler method.

euler.iterations.title: Newton iterations
euler.iterations.description: The most Newton iterations the implicit Euler method makes in a step.

boundary_value.max_iterates.title: BVP maximum iterates
boundary_value.max_iterates.description: The most Newton iterates a boundary value solve makes.

boundary_value.tolerance.title: BVP tolerance
boundary_value.tolerance.description: The tolerance a boundary value solve stops at.

boundary_value.epsilon.title: BVP epsilon
boundary_value.epsilon.description: The step that differences the boundary value problem's Jacobian.

boundary_value.range_steps.title: Boundary value range steps
boundary_value.range_steps.description: How many steps Range shoot makes between its ends.

boundary_value.range_low.title: Boundary value range low
boundary_value.range_low.description: The value Range shoot starts at.

boundary_value.range_high.title: Boundary value range high
boundary_value.range_high.description: The value Range shoot ends at.

boundary_value.range_side.title: Boundary value range side
boundary_value.range_side.description: Which end of the interval Range shoot stores the solution's values at.

boundary_value.range_cycle_color.title: Boundary value range cycle color
boundary_value.range_cycle_color.description: Whether each solution of Range shoot is drawn in the next color.

torus.period.title: Torus period
torus.period.description: The period of the variables that live on a circle or torus. From an XPPAUT .ode: TOR_PER.

torus.fold.title: Torus fold
torus.fold.description: A variable that is taken modulo the torus period; each names one. From an XPPAUT .ode: FOLD.

torus.on.title: Torus on
torus.on.description: Whether the variables folded onto the torus are taken modulo its period.

map.title: Map
map.description: What a run records at a Poincare section: nothing, the section, the maxima or the period. From an XPPAUT .ode: POIMAP.

variable.title: Variable
variable.description: The variable the Poincare section is taken on. From an XPPAUT .ode: POIVAR.

sign.title: Sign
sign.description: Which crossings of the section count: upward, downward or both. From an XPPAUT .ode: POISGN.

plane.title: Plane
plane.description: The value of the variable at the section. From an XPPAUT .ode: POIPLN.

stop.title: Stop
stop.description: Whether a crossing of the section stops the run. From an XPPAUT .ode: POISTOP.

print_eigenvalues.title: Equilibria: print eigenvalues
print_eigenvalues.description: Whether the eigenvalues of an equilibrium are printed.

draw_invariant_sets.title: Equilibria: draw invariant sets
draw_invariant_sets.description: Whether the stable and unstable sets of a saddle are drawn.

draw_strong_sets.title: Equilibria: draw strong sets
draw_strong_sets.description: Whether the strong stable and unstable sets are drawn.

newton.max_iterations.title: Equilibria: maximum iterations
newton.max_iterations.description: The most Newton iterations the search for an equilibrium makes. From an XPPAUT .ode: NEWT_ITER.

newton.tolerance.title: Equilibria: Newton tolerance
newton.tolerance.description: The tolerance the search for an equilibrium stops at. From an XPPAUT .ode: NEWT_TOL.

newton.jacobian_step.title: Equilibria: Jacobian step
newton.jacobian_step.description: The step that differences the Jacobian of the equilibrium search. From an XPPAUT .ode: JAC_EPS.

newton.search_limit.title: Equilibria: search limit
newton.search_limit.description: A state beyond plus or minus this value ends the equilibrium search. From an XPPAUT .ode: BOUND (which also sets integration.state_limit): the one value is both limits.

range.steps.title: Range steps
range.steps.description: How many steps Range equilibria makes between its ends.

range.low.title: Range low
range.low.description: The value Range equilibria starts at.

range.high.title: Range high
range.high.description: The value Range equilibria ends at.

range.shoot.title: Range shoot
range.shoot.description: Whether Range equilibria finds each equilibrium by shooting from the last one.

range.stability_column.title: Range stability column
range.stability_column.description: The data column Range equilibria stores each equilibrium's stability in.

variable.title: Variable
variable.description: The parameter or variable a sweep varies. From an XPPAUT .ode: RANGEOVER.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: How many steps the sweep makes between its ends. From an XPPAUT .ode: RANGESTEP.

low.title: Low
low.description: The value the sweep starts at. From an XPPAUT .ode: RANGELOW.

high.title: High
high.description: The value the sweep ends at. From an XPPAUT .ode: RANGEHIGH.

reset.title: Reset
reset.description: Whether each run of the sweep starts from the initial conditions. From an XPPAUT .ode: RANGERESET.

old_ic.title: Old ic
old_ic.description: Whether each run of the sweep starts where the one before ended. From an XPPAUT .ode: RANGEOLDIC.

write_files.title: Write files
write_files.description: Whether each run of the sweep is written to a file of its own. From an XPPAUT .ode: RANGE.

second_variable.title: Second variable
second_variable.description: The parameter or variable the second sweep of a two-variable range varies.

second_low.title: Second low
second_low.description: The value the second sweep starts at.

second_high.title: Second high
second_high.description: The value the second sweep ends at.

cycle_color.title: Cycle color
cycle_color.description: Whether each run of the sweep is drawn in the next color.

max_branch_switches.title: Max branch switches
max_branch_switches.description: The most times a run switches to another branch.

one_way_branch_switch.title: Switched branches: one way
one_way_branch_switch.description: A branch autoX switches to is followed from the switch point in its starting step's direction only, not both ways.

suppress_branch_points.title: Suppress branch points
suppress_branch_points.description: Whether branch points are left out of the diagram.

follow_all_branches.title: Follow all branches
follow_all_branches.description: Whether a run follows every branch it finds, not only the one it started on.

special_points.title: Special points
special_points.description: The codimension-two points a run detects.

frozen_time.title: Frozen time
frozen_time.description: The value t is held at for a model whose equations use t; empty (the default) refuses such a run.

limits.steps.title: Limits steps
limits.steps.description: The most continuation steps a run takes before it stops. From an XPPAUT .ode: NMAX.

limits.parameter_min.title: Limits parameter min
limits.parameter_min.description: A continuation run stops when the parameter falls below this. From an XPPAUT .ode: PARMIN.

limits.parameter_max.title: Limits parameter max
limits.parameter_max.description: A continuation run stops when the parameter rises above this. From an XPPAUT .ode: PARMAX.

limits.norm_min.title: Limits norm min
limits.norm_min.description: A continuation run stops when the solution's norm falls below this. From an XPPAUT .ode: NORMMIN.

limits.norm_max.title: Limits norm max
limits.norm_max.description: A continuation run stops when the solution's norm rises above this. From an XPPAUT .ode: NORMMAX.

step.initial.title: Step initial
step.initial.description: The first continuation step. From an XPPAUT .ode: DS.

step.min.title: Step min
step.min.description: The smallest continuation step. From an XPPAUT .ode: DSMIN.

step.max.title: Step max
step.max.description: The largest continuation step. From an XPPAUT .ode: DSMAX.

step.adapt_every.title: Step adapt every
step.adapt_every.description: The step size is adapted every this many steps.

mesh.intervals.title: Mesh intervals
mesh.intervals.description: How many mesh intervals a periodic orbit or boundary value solution has. From an XPPAUT .ode: NTST.

mesh.collocation_points.title: Mesh collocation points
mesh.collocation_points.description: The collocation points in each mesh interval. From an XPPAUT .ode: NCOL.

mesh.adapt_every.title: Mesh adapt every
mesh.adapt_every.description: The mesh is adapted every this many steps; 0 keeps it as it is.

newton.parameter_tolerance.title: Newton parameter tolerance
newton.parameter_tolerance.description: The tolerance the parameter converges to in the Newton iteration. From an XPPAUT .ode: EPSL.

newton.state_tolerance.title: Newton state tolerance
newton.state_tolerance.description: The tolerance the state converges to in the Newton iteration. From an XPPAUT .ode: EPSU.

newton.special_point_tolerance.title: Newton special point tolerance
newton.special_point_tolerance.description: The tolerance the special points of a branch are located to. From an XPPAUT .ode: EPSS.

newton.max_iterations.title: Newton max iterations
newton.max_iterations.description: The most Newton iterations in one continuation step.

newton.max_location_iterations.title: Newton max location iterations
newton.max_location_iterations.description: The most iterations that locate a special point.

newton.full_after_steps.title: Full after steps
newton.full_after_steps.description: A full Newton iteration is taken after this many steps; before it the Jacobian is kept.

output.every.title: Output every
output.every.description: A diagram point is kept every this many steps. From an XPPAUT .ode: NPR.

output.detail.title: Output detail
output.detail.description: How much of each point the run writes to the Output.

variable.title: Variable
variable.description: The variable the continuation diagram plots up. From an XPPAUT .ode: AUTOVAR.

x_min.title: X min
x_min.description: The left edge of the continuation diagram. From an XPPAUT .ode: AUTOXMIN.

x_max.title: X max
x_max.description: The right edge of the continuation diagram. From an XPPAUT .ode: AUTOXMAX.

y_min.title: Y min
y_min.description: The bottom edge of the continuation diagram. From an XPPAUT .ode: AUTOYMIN.

y_max.title: Y max
y_max.description: The top edge of the continuation diagram. From an XPPAUT .ode: AUTOYMAX.

colormap.title: Colormap
colormap.description: The colors a color-coded curve or an array plot runs through. From an XPPAUT .ode: COLORMAP.

curves.title: Curves
curves.description: The curves of the starting graph, each with the variables on its axes; the first holds the axes' variables. From an XPPAUT .ode: CURVES.

axes.kind.title: Axes kind
axes.kind.description: A two- or three-dimensional plot. From an XPPAUT .ode: AXES.

axes.x_min.title: Axes x min
axes.x_min.description: The low end of x: the window's left edge in a two-dimensional plot, the box's in a three-dimensional one. From an XPPAUT .ode: XMIN, XLO: wins over the key's other name when both are given; a 2D plot only.

axes.x_max.title: Axes x max
axes.x_max.description: The high end of x: the window's right edge in a two-dimensional plot, the box's in a three-dimensional one. From an XPPAUT .ode: XMAX, XHI: wins over the key's other name when both are given; a 2D plot only.

axes.y_min.title: Axes y min
axes.y_min.description: The low end of y: the window's bottom edge in a two-dimensional plot, the box's in a three-dimensional one. From an XPPAUT .ode: YMIN, YLO: wins over the key's other name when both are given; a 2D plot only.

axes.y_max.title: Axes y max
axes.y_max.description: The high end of y: the window's top edge in a two-dimensional plot, the box's in a three-dimensional one. From an XPPAUT .ode: YMAX, YHI: wins over the key's other name when both are given; a 2D plot only.

axes.z_min.title: Axes z min
axes.z_min.description: The low end of the three-dimensional box in z. From an XPPAUT .ode: ZMIN.

axes.z_max.title: Axes z max
axes.z_max.description: The high end of the three-dimensional box in z. From an XPPAUT .ode: ZMAX.

axes.phi.title: Axes phi
axes.phi.description: The azimuth the three-dimensional plot is viewed from, in degrees. From an XPPAUT .ode: PHI.

axes.theta.title: Axes theta
axes.theta.description: The elevation the three-dimensional plot is viewed from, in degrees. From an XPPAUT .ode: THETA.

line.draw.title: Line draw
line.draw.description: Whether a new curve is drawn as a line, as points or as both. From an XPPAUT .ode: LT (which also sets plot.line.marker, plot.line.marker_size): 1 draws a line; 0 or -n draws points marked with a circle (n its size).

line.dash.title: Line dash
line.dash.description: The dash pattern of a new curve's line.

line.width.title: Line width
line.width.description: The width of a new curve's line.

line.marker.title: Line marker
line.marker.description: The marker drawn at the points of a new curve. From an XPPAUT .ode: LT (which also sets plot.line.draw, plot.line.marker_size): 1 draws a line; 0 or -n draws points marked with a circle (n its size).

line.marker_size.title: Line marker size
line.marker_size.description: The size of the markers of a new curve. From an XPPAUT .ode: LT (which also sets plot.line.draw, plot.line.marker): 1 draws a line; 0 or -n draws points marked with a circle (n its size).

nullclines.mesh.title: Nullcline mesh
nullclines.mesh.description: How many points a side the nullclines are found on. From an XPPAUT .ode: NMESH.

nullclines.draw.title: Nullclines draw
nullclines.draw.description: Whether the nullclines are drawn after a run. From an XPPAUT .ode: NCDRAW (which also sets output.nullclines_file): 0 is false, 1 true; 2 is false and also saves the nullclines to nullclines.dat.

direction_field.grid.title: Direction field grid
direction_field.grid.description: How many arrows a side the direction field has. From an XPPAUT .ode: DFGRID.

direction_field.draw.title: Direction field draw
direction_field.draw.description: What a run draws of the direction field, and whether it also saves it. From an XPPAUT .ode: DFDRAW.

color_by.enabled.title: Color by enabled
color_by.enabled.description: Whether a curve is colored by a quantity along it. From an XPPAUT .ode: COLORIZE.

color_by.via.title: Color by via
color_by.via.description: The variable a color-coded curve takes its color from. From an XPPAUT .ode: COLORVIA.

color_by.low.title: Color by low
color_by.low.description: The value of the coloring variable that gets the first color. From an XPPAUT .ode: COLORLO.

color_by.high.title: Color by high
color_by.high.description: The value of the coloring variable that gets the last color. From an XPPAUT .ode: COLORHI.

array_plot.first_column.title: Array plot first column
array_plot.first_column.description: The first data column the array plot shows.

array_plot.columns.title: Array plot columns
array_plot.columns.description: How many columns the array plot shows.

array_plot.first_row.title: Array plot first row
array_plot.first_row.description: The stored row the array plot starts at, counted from 0.

array_plot.rows.title: Array plot rows
array_plot.rows.description: How many rows the array plot shows.

array_plot.row_skip.title: Array plot row skip
array_plot.row_skip.description: The array plot shows every this many rows of the stored data.

array_plot.z_min.title: Array plot z min
array_plot.z_min.description: The value the array plot gives the first color.

array_plot.z_max.title: Array plot z max
array_plot.z_max.description: The value the array plot gives the last color.

array_plot.top_label.title: Array plot top label
array_plot.top_label.description: The text above the array plot's PDF picture.

array_plot.side_label.title: Array plot side label
array_plot.side_label.description: The text beside the array plot's PDF picture, running up its side.

array_plot.bottom_label.title: Array plot bottom label
array_plot.bottom_label.description: The text under the array plot's PDF picture.

coupling.title: Coupling
coupling.description: The coupling of the H function, one `variable = formula` for each differential equation.

histogram.low.title: Histogram low
histogram.low.description: The low end of the histogram's range. From an XPPAUT .ode: HISTLO.

histogram.high.title: Histogram high
histogram.high.description: The high end of the histogram's range. From an XPPAUT .ode: HISTHI.

histogram.bins.title: Histogram bins
histogram.bins.description: How many bins the histogram has. From an XPPAUT .ode: HISTBINS.

histogram.column.title: Histogram column
histogram.column.description: The column of the data the histogram counts. From an XPPAUT .ode: HISTCOL.

histogram2.low.title: Histogram2 low
histogram2.low.description: The low end of the second axis of the two-dimensional histogram. From an XPPAUT .ode: HISTLO2.

histogram2.high.title: Histogram2 high
histogram2.high.description: The high end of the second axis of the two-dimensional histogram. From an XPPAUT .ode: HISTHI2.

histogram2.bins.title: Histogram2 bins
histogram2.bins.description: How many bins the second axis of the two-dimensional histogram has. From an XPPAUT .ode: HISTBINS2.

histogram2.column.title: Histogram2 column
histogram2.column.description: The column on the second axis of the two-dimensional histogram. From an XPPAUT .ode: HISTCOL2.

spectrum.column.title: Spectrum column
spectrum.column.description: The column of the data the spectrum is taken of. From an XPPAUT .ode: SPECCOL.

spectrum.column2.title: Spectrum column2
spectrum.column2.description: The second column of a cross spectrum or a coherence. From an XPPAUT .ode: SPECCOL2.

spectrum.width.title: Spectrum width
spectrum.width.description: How many points the spectrum's windows are long. From an XPPAUT .ode: SPECWIDTH.

spectrum.window.title: Spectrum window
spectrum.window.description: The window the spectrum's segments are weighted with. From an XPPAUT .ode: SPECWIN.

transpose.first_column.title: Transpose first column
transpose.first_column.description: The first data column Transpose takes.

transpose.columns.title: Transpose columns
transpose.columns.description: How many data columns Transpose takes.

transpose.column_skip.title: Transpose column skip
transpose.column_skip.description: Transpose takes every this many columns of the stored data.

transpose.first_row.title: Transpose first row
transpose.first_row.description: The stored row Transpose starts at, counted from 0.

transpose.rows.title: Transpose rows
transpose.rows.description: How many stored rows Transpose takes.

transpose.row_skip.title: Transpose row skip
transpose.row_skip.description: Transpose takes every this many rows of the stored data.

sliders.title: Sliders
sliders.description: The sliders the window offers: a parameter or variable each, with its range.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.description: The buttons of the window: a label and the command each runs.

data_file.title: Data file
data_file.description: The file a run writes its data to, named from the model's folder. From an XPPAUT .ode: OUTPUT.

picture_file.title: Picture file
picture_file.description: The picture a batch run writes of the graph (PDF or SVG by its extension); empty for none. From an XPPAUT .ode: PLOTFMT.

run_set.title: Run set
run_set.description: The sets a batch run runs, one run each in the model's order; with none, one run with no set.

nullclines_file.title: Nullclines file
nullclines_file.description: The file the nullclines are saved to after a run. From an XPPAUT .ode: NCDRAW (which also sets plot.nullclines.draw): 0 is false, 1 true; 2 is false and also saves the nullclines to nullclines.dat.

after_run.title: After run
after_run.description: What a batch run makes of its data once it has run: an analysis, or the mean or variance of its runs. From an XPPAUT .ode: POSTPROCESS, STOCH: 1 is mean_of_runs, 2 variance_of_runs, 0 none.

after_run_file.title: After run file
after_run_file.description: The file a batch run writes its after-run analysis to.
